title: The F-350 towing the Cougar 23MLE
prompt: A gray 2023 Ford F-350 Super Duty crew cab 4x4 pickup towing a 2025 Keystone Cougar 23MLE fifth-wheel travel trailer, hitched with a fifth-wheel hitch in the truck bed, the trailer's raised front cap riding over the bed. Seen from the right front corner of the truck (three-quarter view from the front, passenger side), the trailer stretching back behind it. The truck: tall wide grille, squared hood, four doors, chunky tires. The trailer: white sides with dark gray and black swoosh graphics, two axles. No logos, badges or lettering.
lookFor: the truck in front, the trailer behind
the trailer's front cap over the truck bed (fifth-wheel hitch), not a ball hitch at the bumper
seen from the truck's right front corner
